facts.big: Go! Read! Use! + I go, I read
facts.label: Imperativo e rotina
facts.sub: Use o verbo base para dar dicas: Go to bed early! Use o present simples para a rotina: I wake up at six.

facts.label: Imperativo
facts.sub: Para dar uma dica ou ordem simples, use só o verbo base: Go to bed early! Read a book! Open the window! Não use you antes do verbo nem -ing.

facts.label: Rotina
facts.sub: Para falar de rotina, use o present simples: I take a warm shower. I drink some tea. Com he, she e it, adicione -s: She wakes up at six.

pages.title: A bright house · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a bright house in Perth. Birds sing in the garden. Marco sits at the kitchen table. He has dark circles under his eyes. His friend Gwen comes in with a cup of tea. She wants to help him sleep better.
“Hi, Marco! You look tired. What time do you go to bed?” says Gwen. “I usually go to bed at midnight. I watch videos first.” says Marco. “Go to bed earlier! Turn off your phone at ten.” says Gwen.

items.why: Com she, o verbo leva -s: drinks.
Com we, a forma base: try.

solo: Aluno responde; você explica o porquê.
group: Cada aluno responde antes de ver a correção.

answers: Yesterday I ___. → slept
She ___ every day. → drinks
He is ___ now. → closing
We ___ every day. → try

items.en: What time do you wake up?

solo: Aluno diz quando usaria cada uma.
group: Expressões-chave: What time do you go to bed? = A que horas você vai dormir?; Go to bed earlier! = Vá dormir mais cedo!; Turn off your phone. = Desligue o celular.; Try it! = Experimente!; Open the window. = Abra a janela.; What time do you wake up? = A que horas você acorda?.
Escolha 3 prioritárias para usar o resto da aula.
